newsitem.title: USA: US stocks seen off despite data.
newsitem.headline: US stocks seen off despite data.

text.p: Wall Street was expected to open lower on Thursday on profit-taking despite figures on October consumer prices and retail sales that reaffirmed a slowing economy with scant inflation.
Philip Orlando, Chief Investment Officer of Value Line Asset Management said: "This tells us the Fed made the right decision yesterday to have no change in monetary policy.
"We are seeing continued economic softness with a complete absence of inflationary pressures. But we're going to have some profit-taking here regardless of the fact we got good numbers."
